features.description: User opens homepage and views fresh ranked flight opportunities.
preconditions: Backend feed-snapshot or observed-fares endpoint is reachable.
user_steps: Navigate to homepage (/)
Observe rendered opportunity cards and curated deal sections.
expected_behavior: Opportunities are ranked by Deal Score and confidence.
Each card shows origin, destination, price, discount badge, airline, and freshness.
Discounts are evidence-gated with capped labels if confidence < 50%.
failure_behavior: If backend is unreachable, displays cached deals or degraded empty state with retry button without crashing.
required_backend_behavior: feed-snapshot or observed-fares returns HTTP 200 with structured JSON envelope and release_sha.
required_data: At least one valid flight deal or observed fare.
required_UI_state: Loading skeleton while fetching, followed by deal card grid or healthy empty message.
required_tests: playwright: e2e/app.spec.ts (homepage renders the opportunity-first experience)

features.description: User views Deal Detail with transparent true-cost breakdown, risk rating, and historical chart.
preconditions: User clicks on a deal card or navigates to /deal/:id.
user_steps: Open deal detail page
Inspect flight schedule, airline, true-cost analyzer, risk rating, price history chart, and grounded AI explanation.
expected_behavior: Displays real total alongside advertised total with itemized fee breakdown (baggage, seats, payment).
Displays route risk level (low, medium, high) with concrete factors (self-transfer, connection buffer).
Renders historical price chart if observations exist, or clean no-data message if history is empty.
Displays grounded explanation clearly labeled as Fact vs System Inference vs AI Explanation.
Booking button links to validated, sanitized HTTPS booking host.
failure_behavior: If deal is not found, renders clean 404/not-found state with return to feed CTA.
required_backend_behavior: Provides deal details and price_history query support.
required_data: Deal row and optional price_history records.
required_UI_state: Full detail layout with schedule card, true cost card, risk card, chart card, and booking CTA.
required_tests: playwright: e2e/app.spec.ts (deal detail exposes evidence, cost and booking action)

features.description: User explores cheap flights by flexible budget, continent/region, and departure window without a fixed destination.
preconditions: Flight opportunities exist across multiple destinations and regions.
user_steps: Navigate to /explore or /search
Filter by origin airport, budget ceiling, region, and date range
Observe filtered destination cards and route insights.
expected_behavior: Displays matching opportunities respecting all active filter constraints.
Shows destination insights (average discount, lowest total cost, best travel score).
Filter changes dynamically update route results without full page reload.
failure_behavior: If no deals match filter criteria, shows helpful empty state suggesting broader budget or dates.
required_backend_behavior: Filtered deal queries or client-side filtering over retrieved dataset.
required_data: Multi-route deals with region and price attributes.
required_UI_state: Filter sidebar/header and responsive results grid.
required_tests: playwright: e2e/app.spec.ts (search applies and persists stop and inclusive date preferences)

features.description: User updates home airport and travel preferences, seeing personalized deal rankings.
preconditions: User opens preferences modal or settings.
user_steps: Select home origin airport (HAN, SGN, DAD, etc.)
Configure max stops, budget, and risk tolerance
Save preferences and return to feed.
expected_behavior: Preferences persist in local storage (guest) and Supabase database (authenticated user).
Feed prioritizes deals matching home origin and budget preferences.
failure_behavior: If network sync fails, guest local preferences remain intact.
required_backend_behavior: user_preferences table RLS protects read/write to authenticated user only.
required_UI_state: Preference settings form with instant feedback.

features.description: User saves deals to bookmarks and tracks their lifecycle status (active, changed, expired).
preconditions: User is browsing deal feed or deal detail.
user_steps: Click bookmark icon on a deal
Navigate to /saved
Review bookmarked deals with status badges.
expected_behavior: Deal is added to bookmarks list immediately.
Bookmark status displays ACTIVE if deal is current, or EXPIRED if past departure/validity date.
User can remove bookmarks with one click.
failure_behavior: Empty bookmarks page shows clean placeholder with link back to explore deals.
required_backend_behavior: user_bookmarks table with RLS isolation for authenticated users.
required_UI_state: Saved deals page with filterable list.
required_tests: playwright: e2e/app.spec.ts (saved deals page has a stable empty state without live deals)

features.description: User creates a route price alert with Cloudflare Turnstile verification.
preconditions: User navigates to /alerts or clicks set alert on a deal.
user_steps: Enter origin and destination
Set target price or discount threshold
Provide email or Telegram address
Complete Turnstile verification and submit.
expected_behavior: Client validates inputs and receives Turnstile token.
setup-alert Edge Function verifies token server-side and checks rate-limit budget.
Alert is created in pending status and confirmation dispatch is triggered.
UI displays success confirmation message.
failure_behavior: Invalid email or rejected Turnstile token displays inline error message without submitting.
required_backend_behavior: Turnstile siteverify validation and atomic budget consumption in request_rate_limits.
required_UI_state: Alert form with Turnstile widget, loading state, and success view.
required_tests: playwright: e2e/app.spec.ts (alert form creates a valid alert and reaches the success state)

features.description: User receives deduplicated price drop notification with signed unsubscribe link.
preconditions: Active, confirmed alert exists in price_alerts matching a newly published deal.
user_steps: Background alert-processor executes on schedule
User receives email or Telegram alert
User can click unsubscribe link to cancel alert.
expected_behavior: Alert matches deal criteria (route, price, discount, date range).
Deduplication suppresses multiple notifications within 24 hours for the same deal.
Notification includes route, price, savings, and HMAC-signed one-click unsubscribe URL.
Unsubscribe link cancels alert without requiring login.
failure_behavior: Transient provider failure triggers bounded exponential retry (1m, 5m, 15m) without double-sending.
required_backend_behavior: alert-processor evaluates matches, records notification_logs, and updates last_notified_at.
required_UI_state: AlertActionPage (/alert-action) renders confirmation or unsubscribe outcome.
required_tests: playwright: e2e/app.spec.ts (alert unsubscribe rejects a link without signed parameters)

features.description: User sees honest freshness indicator (healthy, degraded, stale) with re-check guidance.
preconditions: Observed fares or feed snapshots are loaded.
user_steps: View deal cards on feed, search, or detail page
Inspect freshness badge (e.g. 'Quan sát trong 1 giờ', 'Quan sát 5 giờ trước').
expected_behavior: Observations <= 120 min show green healthy badge.
Observations 121-360 min show yellow degraded freshness badge.
Observations > 360 min show orange stale warning with recommendation to verify on airline website.
failure_behavior: If all observations are stale, page header prominently alerts user that deals are historical/stale.
required_tests: playwright: e2e/app.spec.ts (deals page distinguishes a degraded feed from healthy zero inventory)

features.description: Keyboard and screen-reader user navigates application cleanly with 44px tap targets and skip links.
preconditions: User accesses application with keyboard (Tab/Shift-Tab) or screen reader.
user_steps: Press Tab on initial page load to reveal skip-to-content link
Navigate through navigation bar, filter controls, deal cards, and modal dialogs.
expected_behavior: Skip link moves focus directly to main content area.
Interactive buttons and touch targets meet minimum 44x44px dimensions.
Focus rings are clearly visible on all focused elements.
All icon buttons (bookmarks, close, menu) have aria-label attributes.
failure_behavior: No focus traps or invisible interactive controls.
required_UI_state: Semantic HTML elements with ARIA roles.
required_tests: playwright: e2e/app.spec.ts (privacy and accessibility foundations are reachable)

features.description: Authenticated user requests account deletion, triggering transactional purging of user data.
preconditions: User is logged in and navigates to privacy settings.
user_steps: Open account privacy settings
Click delete account, type explicit confirmation 'DELETE_MY_ACCOUNT'
Submit deletion request.
expected_behavior: Server verifies authenticated identity and exact confirmation phrase.
Transactionally deletes user preferences, bookmarks, alerts, and auth records.
Logs one-way hashed deletion audit entry without storing user UUID in plaintext.
Logs user out and redirects to goodbye/home page.
failure_behavior: Mismatched confirmation phrase or missing auth fails closed with 400/401 error.
required_backend_behavior: manage-user-data Edge Function invokes transactional SQL procedure.
required_UI_state: Confirmation dialog with text input and destructive confirmation button.

features.description: Developer/CI replays representative provider fixtures offline without live quota.
preconditions: Test fixtures exist for FastFlights, Amadeus, and SerpApi in repository.
user_steps: Run npm test or npm run test:functions.
expected_behavior: All provider parsers normalize fixtures into standard flight offer schemas.
Fails closed if provider structure changes unexpectedly.
failure_behavior: Test fails with clear assertion diff if normalization contract is broken.

features.description: Application gracefully degrades to cached/historical inventory during provider outage without crashing.
preconditions: External provider API returns HTTP 500/503 or network times out.
user_steps: User opens homepage or search page during provider outage.
expected_behavior: System falls back to cached feed snapshots or local storage cache.
Displays degraded inventory notice without throwing unhandled exceptions.
Retry button allows user to check again when service restores.
failure_behavior: No blank screens or raw stack traces.
required_backend_behavior: feed-snapshot returns status: provider_unavailable with retryable: true.
required_UI_state: Degraded status banner and cached card grid.
